ask_hint: Questions about this space, answered by Claude from your totals
ask_intro: Ask about your spending, income, budgets, balances or what is coming up. Claude looks up the totals it needs and answers in a few sentences.
ask_privacy: Your question and the totals Claude asks for (sums per category, month or payee, budgets, balances, upcoming payments) go to Anthropic. Single transactions are not sent.
